text:
emma: Heads-up — internal telemetry shows ~0.7% of service-to-service connections negotiated TLS 1.2. Proposing we enforce TLS 1.3 only for control-plane and internal APIs. Quick confirmations needed:
- any legacy clients we should keep supporting?
- who owns rotation for control-plane keys in KMS/HSM?
- logging redaction: ensure session tickets / raw ClientHello not stored.
PR linking redaction changes: https://git.company/infra-logging/pulls/2345
Ping @raj @maria @kyle for input.

raj: Quick check — last compatibility sweep in Nov said no major legacy consumers, but we do have an on-prem integrator (cust-X) that uses an older TLS stack. I can open a ticket to contact them. I own the KMS key for control-plane (kms:cp-keys). Rotation policy is monthly by default; we can trigger an ad-hoc rotation if we flip policy.

maria: re: logs — agree we must redact tls session tickets and client hello raw bytes. Our redact rules live in infra-logging: https://git.company/infra-logging/policies. PR #2345 adds rules for `ssl.session_ticket` and `tls.client_hello_raw` and a small linter so people don't accidentally log raw TLS fields. lgtm from devex. :thumbsup:

kyle: SRE note — if we set min TLS to 1.3, validate ALBs, sidecars, and envoy filters support the 1.3 cipher suites. I'll run a staging canary tomorrow and post results. Quick local test I use:
```bash
openssl s_client -connect service-internal:443 -tls1_3
```
Canary plan: stage namespace -> 5% traffic -> 24h smoke. Will capture handshakes and errors.

security-bot: Rotation summary for kms:cp-keys — last rotated 1767150000, next automated rotation scheduled 1769840000. Current access grants: service-accounts:deploy-bot (pending review). No known expired certs.

raj: I'll remove deploy-bot grant post-canary and file the on-prem cust-X outreach ticket. Who signs off on the policy change for control-plane TLS? @emma? :eyes:

emma: I'll sign off once staging canary passes and PR #2345 is merged. @kyle please add canary results and any envoy/ALB diffs to the ticket. Also loop in legal if outreach to customers is required. Approving contingent on no regressions. :white_check_mark:

maria: tagging ops-docs — we should add a short runbook for rolling back TLS min-version and for rolling key rotations.

kyle: will do. scheduling canary for 10:00 PT tomorrow, will update thread. :rocket:
